---
name: project-validation
description: Review 3DEngelen project content and image references without changing files.
---

Read the requested `projects/<slug>/project.md` and `pictures/` folder, then run `npm run check` and `npm run build`. Report each problem with its exact file path, field or line, and suggested fix. Verify required metadata, `YYYY-MM` completion, hero and optional SEO/gallery references, link URLs, supported images, image ordering, and whether prose claims are supported by the supplied material. Check for missing alt/caption context and accidental drafts or personal data. Do not modify any file unless explicitly asked; distinguish confirmed errors from editorial suggestions.
